what: GRAPPLEMAP1: the GrappleMap positions and transitions that map to the card game's BJJ cards (proto/cardgame/cards.mjs), cut from GrappleMap.txt.
by: Arena seat, S540. Only the moves in `cards` are kept; ids are the file's own record order (positions first, then transitions), which is also how the game's grapple graph numbers them.

source.license: All authors involved in the creation of the contents of this package have agreed to release their respective contributions into the Public Domain.

cards.name: sprawl to head&arm
cards.why: a sprawl on a low double leg that ends in GrappleMap's named sprawl position: the card answers a takedown (tagged sprawl, top).

card.vs: a hold or a pass as it is laid; played in your turn: stand up

cards.name: stand up escape
cards.why: the bottom player stands up out of a pass being laid, which is exactly the card's printed act: stand up (tagged stand_up, bottom).

cards.name: hip bump sweep
cards.why: the bottom player in a broken-open closed guard rolls up and over: the card's own sweep from B0/B1, and GrappleMap tags it sweep (bottom).

cards.name: bull fighter pass
from: standing vs supine w/ legs extended
cards.why: the standing player walks the legs aside and comes down past them: the card is an advance from the top rungs T0-T2, and GrappleMap tags it pass_around (top).

cards.name: triangle
cards.why: the bottom player closes a triangle from full guard, which is the card's own B0 range (bottom).

cards.name: arm bar
cards.why: the arm bar is finished and GrappleMap lands on its own position named "arm lock", tagged armbar (bottom).

cards.name: rear naked choke
to: rear naked choke w/ arm trapped
cards.why: the rear naked choke from back control with the arm trapped: the card's T3 range, tagged rear_naked_choke.

cards.name: kimura
cards.why: the kimura finishes into GrappleMap's "half guard kimura", the card's own B1/T1 half guard rungs (tagged kimura).
